title: Require Domain Aggregate Source Topology
forbids: domain aggregate roots outside their required public composition spine

remediate: Add index.ts, contract.ts, and router.ts; move every other direct file authority behind its owning semantic subdomain.
message: Domain aggregate roots should match the positive domain blueprint spine.
